name: Spring water surface and splashes
oneLiner: Pits, ponds and lakes of a side-view game get a surface made of springs: anything that falls in throws a crown of droplets and a curved splash sheet and sends waves to both banks that reflect and calm down (damped, clamped, fixed sub-steps: it never blows up). Bodies the game lists splash once per entry (tested along their path, so a fast arrow still splashes), drip when they leave and push a bow wave while wading; floaters bob, tilt and never overlap or sink; under the line the water tints what is in it, mirrors the bank, shows light shafts, foam and bubbles; an optional waterfall keeps feeding a pool. Pixel and HD renders, deterministic from the seed.
fits: side-view adventure with lakes or sewers
notFor: top-down games (the surface is a side-view line)
games that need real swimming physics (the module draws and floats; the game keeps its own movement rules)

needs: pool rects in world px (the pits / ponds: x, w, the water line y, the depth)
bodies(): top-left boxes {id, x, y, w, h} of the hero, enemies and projectiles with stable ids
a fixed update step (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1), update(0) while stopped
the draw pass: water.draw after the sprites, before the HUD, in the sprites' space
the game's own art for floating props (optional)
provides: entry splash per body (crown of droplets, splash sheet, foam ring, bubbles), exit drips, wading wake; onSplash / onSound hooks
spring surface with travelling, reflecting, damped waves and a gentle breeze
floaters that bob, tilt, drift and stay on the surface without overlapping (addFloater)
waterfalls (falls) with a churning foot, mist and spray
water drawn over what is in it: tint by depth, reflection, light shafts, foam, bubbles (pixel and smooth renders)
queries: surfaceY, restY, floorY, depthAt, inWater, poolAt; splash(), bubble(), clear(), stats(), hash(), events()

params.label: Add a waterfall where a wall rises over a pool

assets: module/water-surface.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_WaterSurface): spring columns, entry / exit detection, droplets, sheets, bubbles, mist, foam, floaters, waterfalls, pixel and smooth renders
no image, font or audio files
